Quick notes:
- We've seen this when the event's organizer metadata is rewritten by some calendar proxies and the attendee-facing join URL gets replaced with a redirect.
- As a quick workaround, I'm dropping a Zoom backup link below and asking Dylan (copied) to resend a corrected .ics that explicitly sets the organizer to your Harbor account.

Zoom (backup): https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=redwood-demo
Passcode: 4821

Lara — if you prefer we can keep the original Meet time and just switch the calendar entry. Which do you prefer?

Hi Lara and Marissa — I dug into the invite: the event was created by our internal meeting bridge service which adds a join token; some mailbox routing rules at Harbor are rewriting the outgoing join link to point at portal.harboranalytics.com. Two ways to resolve:

1) Reissue a calendar event where the organizer is Lara (your Harbor service account). That preserves your host controls (recommended).
2) Keep the Redwood event but assign co-host rights to Lara and use the Zoom backup link Marissa provided.

I attached an .ics (20270718-redwood-alt-join.ics) with the organizer set to lara.jennings@harboranalytics.com and explicit Zoom join URL in the DESCRIPTION field. If you accept that invite it should show in your calendar as Harbor-organized and avoid the redirect.

Attachment: 20270718-redwood-alt-join.ics

I can also perform an organizer transfer if you tell me which Harbor account should be the organizer (lara.jennings@harboranalytics.com?).

—Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
dylan.brooks@redwood.inference
